description: Animated explainer slides for programming videos — turns one technical problem (backend, database, system design, frontend, infra) into a deck of 1920×1080 HTML scenes that teach the mechanism: requests travel, scans crawl, races interleave, the bottleneck lights up. Picks a story arc, drafts a storyboard with one shared fact sheet (same data, consistent numbers on every slide) for your approval, then renders standalone per-slide HTML plus one single-file deck with step-by-step reveals, speaker notes, and a clean recording mode, to out/archdeck/<slug>/. No codebase needed. Use for "make slides explaining X for my video", "animated architecture slides for a tutorial", "turn this system design problem into a presentation" — e.g. "/archdeck keyset vs offset pagination". For docs and mermaid diagrams of a real codebase use blueprint; to be taught a topic interactively use learn.
